note: LRRC7-related neurodevelopmental disorder is characterized by aggression and hyperphagia-associated obesity, supporting differential diagnostic utility against other synaptopathies.

evidence.text: A cohort study identifying 33 individuals with heterozygous LRRC7 variants reported a clinical spectrum specifically involving intellectual disability, autism, ADHD, aggression, and hyperphagia-associated obesity.

source.title: Variants in LRRC7 lead to intellectual disability, autism, aggression and abnormal eating behaviors
source.quote: The clinical spectrum involves intellectual disability, autism, ADHD, aggression and, in several cases, hyperphagia-associated obesity.
